title: Parador Baseboard SL 4 External Corner Repair Fix
author: neustroew
description:
This corner was specially developed for the Parador Baseboard SL 4 model to elegantly conceal damaged areas or untidy miters.

**Why this print?**

**\- Easy Retrofitting:**

Unlike the original components, which must be installed directly when mounting the baseboards, this version can be fitted at any time afterwards.

**\- Color Freedom:**

The originals are only available in silver. With this model, you can print the corner in a matching baseboard color (e.g., white).

**\- Conceal Damage:**

Perfect for making scuffed MDF edges or gaps at external corners invisible.

**- Installation:**

Simply fix with a dab of hot glue. Fast, clean, and stable!
